record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add label smoothing of 0.02 to the existing masked-item cross-entropy over real-item classes, retaining temperature 0.8 and uniform masked-target averaging. Mild smoothing may reduce overconfidence without the stronger temperature or recency-weighting changes that regressed. Preserve features, embeddings, backbone, scoring, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Retain one model per category and unchanged appended-mask inference.
